---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new scenario, pathogen, intervention, or capability
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like added?**
A clear description. If this is a new pathogen or scenario, please include:
- Proposed parameter values with sources (see CONTRIBUTING.md's "Adding or
  changing a parameter estimate" section — every parameter needs a real,
  checkable source)
- Any real-world outbreak data that could serve as an `observed_outcomes`
  validation benchmark

**Is this related to a limitation in `docs/roadmap.md`?**
Check `docs/roadmap.md` first — your request may already be a scoped, prioritized
roadmap item, in which case linking it here is more useful than restating it.

**Additional context**
Anything else relevant (a paper, a use case, a related issue).
